0x010E.name: ImageDescription
0x010E.description: Text describing the image, which may contain notes or subject identifiers.

0x010F.name: Make
0x010F.description: Manufacturer of the recording equipment (e.g., Apple, Canon, Sony).

0x0110.name: Model
0x0110.description: Model name or number of the recording equipment (identifies device model).

0x0112.name: Orientation
0x0112.description: The image orientation relative to the camera sensor (1=Horizontal, 6=Rotate 90 CW, etc.).

0x011A.name: XResolution
0x011A.description: Number of pixels per resolution unit in the width direction.

0x011B.name: YResolution
0x011B.description: Number of pixels per resolution unit in the height direction.

0x0128.name: ResolutionUnit
0x0128.description: Unit used for XResolution and YResolution (e.g., inches, cm).

0x0131.name: Software
0x0131.description: Software or firmware version used to produce or edit the image.

0x0132.name: DateTime
0x0132.description: File change date and time (indicates modification history).

0x013B.name: Artist
0x013B.description: Name of the photographer or creator, potentially revealing real personal identity.

0x8298.name: Copyright
0x8298.description: Copyright notice identifying the photographer or copyright holder.

0x829A.name: ExposureTime
0x829A.description: Exposure time in seconds or fractional seconds.

0x8769.name: ExifIFDPointer
0x8769.description: Offset to the private EXIF IFD block.

0x8825.name: GPSInfoIFDPointer
0x8825.description: Offset to the GPS IFD block.

0x8822.name: ExposureProgram
0x8822.description: Class of the program used by the camera to set exposure.

0x9000.name: ExifVersion
0x9000.description: Version of the supported EXIF standard.

0x9003.name: DateTimeOriginal
0x9003.description: Exact date and time when the original photo was captured (reveals timeline/routine).

0x9004.name: DateTimeDigitized
0x9004.description: Date and time when the image was stored as digital data.

0x9011.name: OffsetTimeOriginal
0x9011.description: Time zone offset when the photo was shot (reveals geographic time zone).

0x9201.name: ShutterSpeedValue
0x9201.description: Shutter speed value in APEX units.

0x9202.name: ApertureValue
0x9202.description: Lens aperture value in APEX units.

0x9206.name: SubjectDistance
0x9206.description: Distance to the subject in meters.

0x9207.name: MeteringMode
0x9207.description: Metering mode used by the camera.

0x9209.name: Flash
0x9209.description: Flash status when the picture was taken.

0x920A.name: FocalLength
0x920A.description: Actual focal length of the lens in mm.

0x927C.name: MakerNote
0x927C.description: Manufacturer proprietary metadata, often containing serial numbers, facial detection records, or device logs.

0x9286.name: UserComment
0x9286.description: User or application comments attached to the picture.

0xA002.name: PixelXDimension
0xA002.description: Valid width of meaningful image data.

0xA003.name: PixelYDimension
0xA003.description: Valid height of meaningful image data.

0xA420.name: ImageUniqueID
0xA420.description: Unique identifier assigned to the picture, allowing tracking across web platforms.

0xA430.name: CameraOwnerName
0xA430.description: Owner name programmed into the camera.

0xA431.name: BodySerialNumber
0xA431.description: Camera serial number (uniquely identifies physical hardware).

0xA435.name: LensSerialNumber
0xA435.description: Lens serial number (uniquely identifies lens hardware).
